newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares firm 0.8 pct but off highs.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares firm 0.8 pct but off highs.

text.p: Istanbul shares firmed an average 0.81 percent in selective activity on Thursday, but afternoon profit-taking sparked by stiff resistance erased part of the early gains, brokers said.

The IMKB-100 .ISEC closed up 522.3 points at 65,138.93, bringing three-day gains to 3.55 percent after Monday's 0.8 percent drop. It brushed a high of 65,790 in the day. Trade volume eased to 8.33 trillion lira ($93.6 million) from Wednesday's 8.91 trillion ($100.3 million).

"It was again proven that resistance at between 65,000-65,500 is a strong one. I think the three-day upward move which was fuelled by state shares has died down. Initial support is now awaited at 64,000," said Cenk Akyoldas from Yatirim Finansman securities.
A technical recovery had begun with the help of limited cash influx, after support of the index was confirmed at 62,500 on Monday.
